bio: Anna Maria was born on 25 May 1692, daughter of Ferdinando Maletta and Isabella Moraca ([R4-S1]). She married Antonio Villella on 24 July 1713 ([R4-S2]) and was buried as a widow on 10 January 1762 ([R4-S3]).
